description: Is a value coerced when it is assigned to Parameter.Value, or only at open? For parameters declared Long, Byte, Bit, DateTime, Currency and Text(5) (PARAMETERS pX <type>; SELECT pX AS v FROM ONE;), the values Text '5', Double 2.5, Boolean True, Null, Empty, Long -1 and Text 'abc' are assigned in turn and Parameter.Value is read back after each (VARIANT tag and value); nothing is opened. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text goes into a temporary QueryDef (CreateQueryDef with an empty name, then DBEngine.Errors).
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
